i.norm:
Verifies the unbounded Levenshtein distance between two sequences that share a single matching character but differ in length.

The sequences are built from char arrays so that every unset position is the NUL character ('�'):

  • left (length 8): 'S' at indexes 0, 2 and 5, NUL elsewhere
  • right (length 7): 'S' at index 3, NUL elsewhere

Converting left into right needs 3 edits, none of which is a substitution.
